sections.shortTitle: Sindh Local Government Ninth Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XLVIII OF 2002
SINDH LOCAL
GOVERNMENT (NINTH AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XLVIII OF
2002
An Ordinance to further amend the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 2001
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 27th December, 2002]
No.S.Legis:1(48)/2002, dated
27-12-2002. The following Ordinance made by the Governor of the Sindh is
hereby published for general information:-
1. Short title and
commencement.----(1) This Ordinance may be called the Sindh Local
Government (Ninth Amendment) Ordinance, 200;.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Local Government Ninth Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Amendment of section 181-A of the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 2001

ORDINANCE XLVIII OF 2002
SINDH LOCAL
GOVERNMENT (NINTH AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XLVIII OF
2002
An Ordinance to further amend the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 2001
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 27th December, 2002]
No.S.Legis:1(48)/2002, dated
27-12-2002. The following Ordinance made by the Governor of the Sindh is
hereby published for general information:-
2. Amendment of section 181-A
of the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 2001.---In the Sindh Local
Government Ordinance, 2001, for section 181-A, the following shall be
substituted:-
"Internal
Recall of Nazims.181-A. Notwithstanding anything contained in sections 24, 63
and 85 and internal recall motion shall not be moved in the case of Taluka
Nazim, Town Nazim or Union Nazim before the 31st December, 2002 and in the case
of Zila Nazim before the 30th June, 2003. ".
